item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished professional logo icon for an independent plant shop. A graceful leafy sprout with three distinctive leaves growing from a simple terracotta flowerpot, subtly integrated into a circular botanical emblem. Flat vector-style design, clean confident curves, balanced geometric proportions, strong silhouette, minimal detail, readable at small sizes. Palette: deep forest green, soft sage green, muted terracotta, on a plain warm ivory background. Friendly, organic, contemporary boutique identity. Center one single logo with generous negative space. No text, no letters, no typography, no watermark, no mockup, no photography, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D.
